timecoded_text_to_speech.text: We really wanted to make music on our own and this was a real possible way of doing music at home completely free and with nobody's help.
And you know, we didn't want to ask anybody anything.
You may have already guessed by their unique headgear that the lads are a tad iconoclastic.
The masks are always worn for media interviews because they say they don't want to be known for their looks.
We don't want to be famous physically.
So we just want to spread our music and share the music we make.
And our physical appearance is totally relevant.
